name: Aloft Jakarta Kebon Jeruk
short_description: A design-forward lifestyle hotel atop AKR Tower in Kebon Jeruk, West Jakarta. Opened November 2025 with 150 rooms, a level-33 infinity pool, rooftop W XYZ bar and all-day dining, linked to Museum MACAN.
ai_summary: Aloft Jakarta Kebon Jeruk opened on 17 November 2025 as Marriott's newest Bonvoy lifestyle property in West Jakarta, occupying the upper floors of AKR Tower on Jalan Panjang. It is the Aloft brand's third hotel in Jakarta and directly connected to Museum MACAN, Indonesia's leading contemporary-art venue, with Central Park, Neo Soho and Mall Taman Anggrek all within roughly a 5 km radius. The 150-room property leans into the brand's music-and-design energy: a neon-and-LED sky lobby with skyline views, a level-33 infinity-edge pool, a 24-hour Re:charge gym, and more than 1,600 sqm of meeting and ballroom space. Rooms run from 27 sqm Sky King and Twin layouts to 52 sqm Sky Suites, with floor-to-ceiling windows, 55-inch smart TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi. Dining centres on CHIO CHIO all-day dining (Peranakan-inspired menu, buffet breakfast, weekend dim sum brunch) and the rooftop W XYZ bar with live music. Because the hotel is only months old, only a small number of early guest reviews exist and any rating should be read as provisional; the location suits business and lifestyle travellers more than tourists, with limited walkability nearby.

Sizeable meeting and ballroom space (1,600+ sqm) suited to events and corporate stays

Set atop AKR Tower with sky lobby and pool on the upper floors (approx. levels 29 and 33), connected to Museum MACAN
Aloft's third Jakarta property and part of Marriott's growing Indonesia lifestyle footprint
research_watchouts: TripAdvisor page exists but with only a handful of early reviews; no reliable numeric rating could be independently verified
Nearly all online coverage is opening press releases or OTA/TripAdvisor listings; no substantive independent long-form review or verified YouTube tour was found

faqs.question: When did Aloft Jakarta Kebon Jeruk open?
faqs.answer: The hotel opened on 17 November 2025 in the AKR Tower on Jalan Panjang, Kebon Jeruk, West Jakarta. As a new property it has only a small number of guest reviews so far.

faqs.question: How far is it from Soekarno-Hatta Airport and Central Park mall?
faqs.answer: It is roughly a 30-minute drive (about 22 km) from Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK), and around a 10-minute drive from Central Park mall, with Neo Soho and Mall Taman Anggrek also close by.

faqs.question: What facilities does the hotel have?
faqs.answer: Highlights include a level-33 infinity-edge pool, a 24-hour Re:charge gym, the rooftop W XYZ bar, CHIO CHIO all-day dining, a neon-lit sky lobby, and over 1,600 sqm of meeting and ballroom space. It is also directly connected to Museum MACAN.
